title: Product Manufacturer Not Liable If Product Meant For Use Under Expert Supervision With Adequate Warnings

content.scenario: A product manufacturer sold a product that was legally meant to be used or dispensed only by or under the supervision of an expert or a class of experts. The product manufacturer had employed reasonable means to give the warnings or instructions for usage of such product to such expert or class of experts. Later, a complainant used the product and was harmed. The product manufacturer is not liable because the product was one which was legally meant to be used or dispensed only by or under the supervision of an expert or a class of experts and the product manufacturer had employed reasonable means to give the warnings or instructions for usage of such product to such expert or class of experts.
content.outcome: The product manufacturer is not liable for the harm caused to the complainant because the product was one which was legally meant to be used or dispensed only by or under the supervision of an expert or a class of experts and the product manufacturer had employed reasonable means to give the warnings or instructions for usage of such product to such expert or class of experts.
